name: Retro target label
what: A dot and a tiny disc appear, a comet sweeps round the disc leaving an orange and a yellow ring behind it while a tilted label grows on the disc and straightens; the ring blinks twice and the whole target swells to full size around the label, then holds.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4 (00:00:00:04) a dot appears left of the centre and a tiny disc at the centre; f8-f42 (00:00:00:08-00:00:01:12) the comet sweeps round (orange band, the yellow band 4 f behind), the disc grows to 0.6 of the ring and the label straightens from sideways to level by f40 (00:00:01:10); f42 the orange ring closes; f44 and f48 (00:00:01:14, 00:00:01:18) the yellow ring blinks off for two frames while the target swells; it grows to full size by f86 (00:00:02:26) with a decelerating curve; hold to f149 (00:00:04:29)

tracks.name: dot and disc
tracks.what: an orange dot beside the centre and a tiny disc at the centre appear

tracks.name: comet
tracks.what: the orange band sweeps round clockwise, the yellow band follows 4 frames behind; both close into rings
tracks.easing: S-curve (slow start, fast middle, long decelerating end)

tracks.name: disc and label
tracks.what: the disc grows to 0.6 of the ring size; the label grows on it and straightens from sideways to level

tracks.name: pulse
tracks.what: the yellow ring blinks off for two frames, twice, as the target starts to swell

tracks.name: swell
tracks.what: the whole target grows from 0.6 to full size
